segments.name: Bicycle and racket
segments.description: Develops and sells key structural parts of bicycles and rackets, plus cranks and other products, for customers.
segments.evidence: As a result, the Group operates as a single reporting segment, primarily engaged in bicycle, racket, and other businesses.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for bicycle parts, rackets, cranks and services, sold under ODM, OEM and trading arrangements.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue decreased for the year ended December 31, 2025 due to a change in our business model from OEM to trading.

changes.text: In April 2023, the Group disposed of its two PRC operating subsidiaries and began operating as a single reporting segment.
changes.evidence: After April 1, 2023, the Group disposed of two PRC subsidiaries, YMA DG and Forwell.
